doc: The glide and glider-dive poses every Hunter on Meshy's skeleton shares (scripts/heroes/warden_glide_pose.gd, docs/art/wardens/MESHY_NATIVE.md). Each pose names Meshy's bones (the Left ones; the Right ones mirror) and the way each points to its child, in the body's frame: x the body's left, y up (hips to head), z forward (toes), each Hunter's frame read off its own rest skeleton, so one pose fits every body (a bone's child: the mean of its children's heads). tilt: deg that bone pitches about the body's left-right axis (+: its top forward). sway: [deg, phase rad] that bone's direction swings about the body's left-right axis once per loop (legs together, never in turn: no stride). A Hunter's data clips glide / dive override the pose (WardenNative).
